items.title: Everyone Wants Their Own Dollar: Why Corporations Are Issuing Stablecoin
items.snippet: On June 30, 2026, Circle’s share price closed down about 17% . No depeg had happened. No exchange had failed. A group of 140 companies had announced they were building a dollar of their own, and the market immediately repriced what that means for the incumbent. The group calls itself Open Standard, and the token is Open USD, ticker OUSD. Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, Coinbase, BlackRock, and BNY are all in it. The coin has not shipped yet, with native issuance on Solana planned for later this year....
